explication: Flowable is a Java workflow/BPM platform combining BPMN process, CMMN case, and DMN decision engines, with Java and REST APIs and Spring integration. Its principal user journey is to submit work through an API, have an engine orchestrate process/case activity and decisions, and retrieve resulting state; the README describes these capabilities but does not establish detailed runtime routing. The sampled code confirms shared command/session infrastructure, entity persistence/event handling, CMMN agenda creation, and external-worker job querying. Dashed, uncited links represent documented capabilities whose implementation wiring was not sampled.
